request: Test ordered worker results for distinct inputs.

defects.description: Appending results while ranging over the lookup map discards input order, so six distinct inputs do not return in their original order.

trigger.expected: actual: output order matches input: true (output count=6)
trigger.actual: actual: output order matches input: false (output count=6)

defects.why_missed: The happy-path tests use one input or repeated copies of one value; neither can expose ordering across distinct inputs.

traps.description: Repeated inputs intentionally produce one result because duplicate inputs are deduped before processing.
